----- 
Coram:Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rongon Mukhopadhyay Hon'Ble Mr. Justice
Pradeep Kumar Srivastava

--------
For the Appellant : Mr. Randhir Kumar, Advocate For the State : Mr. Vishwanath Roy, Spl.P.P.

th Order No. 03/ Dated: 08 August, 2025 I.A. No. 7344 of 2025 Heard Mr. Randhir Kumar, learned counsel for the appellant and Mr. Vishwanath Roy, learned Spl. P.P. appearing for the State.
2. This interlocutory application has been preferred by the appellant for grant of bail to him during the pendency of this appeal.
3. The appellant has been convicted for the offence under Section 376 of the IPC and has been sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for 10 years along with fine of Rs. 25,000/-.
4. It has been alleged that the appellant had established physical relationship with the informant as a result of which she had become pregnant.
The appellant had advised the victim to get the fetus aborted and had solemnized marriage with another person.

5. It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the appellant that while referring the evidence of the informant as well as her mother that both were knowing that the appellant was previously married and in spite of the said fact the victim who is a major lady had accepted the overtures made by the appellant and had permitted him to establish physical relationship with her.
It has been Jubair Ansari @ Juber Ansari vs The State Of Jharkhand on 8 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/33238882/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 submitted that appellant is in custody since long.
6. Mr. Vishwanath Roy, learned Spl. P.P. has opposed the prayer for the bail of the appellant.

7. Regard being had to the evidence of the victim from which it could be deciphered that there was a relationship between the appellant and the victim who is a major and which resulted in her becoming pregnant and giving birth to a child, we are inclined to admit the appellant on bail.
Accordingly, during the pendency of this appeal, appellant, above named, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Addl. Sessions Judge-II, Koderma in S.T. Case No. 145 of 2023 arising out of Chandwara P.S. Case No. 22 of 2023.
8. The aforesaid I.A. stands allowed and disposed of.
